target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/shadow_frontier/catalog && rm -f ghost_catalog.aux ghost_catalog.log
cd /home/john/mynotes
git add shadow_frontier/catalog
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Shadow Frontier: ghost catalog (120 pilot candidates + Sturmian data)

catalog/ghost_catalog.tex/pdf (12pp): deterministic regeneration of the
pilot-001 candidate counterexamples (seed 1, M=240, alphabet {1,2,4},
calibrated mean log2(3), ord-3 bias) with full statistics table (mean,
bias, P(16), B_240, representative/modulus bits, fill ratio - all ~1,
all ghosts) and the complete words in the appendix; plus ten critical-
slope Sturmian ghosts with realizability data (now provably
non-realizable by repetition rigidity). make_catalog.py regenerates
everything from the frontier.py machinery.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" -- shadow_frontier/catalog 2>&1 | tail -1
git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -1
cd /home/john/mynotes/shadow_frontier && ailog add --tool claude-code --level-hint 1 --text "Ghost catalog composed (catalog/ghost_catalog.tex/pdf, 12pp, committed+pushed): deterministic regeneration of all 120 pilot-001 candidate words (seed 1, M=240, {1,2,4}, calibrated + ord-3-biased) with statistics longtable (mean b, |D_3|, P(16), B_240, rep bits, mod bits, fill ratio ~ 1 for all - every candidate a ghost, none stabilizing between N=120 and N=240) and full words in appendix; ten critical-slope Sturmian ghosts with realizability table (rep bits at N=100/200 riding the diagonal) and example words - labeled as PROVABLY non-realizable per repetition rigidity. Catalog frames all objects as points of Z_2; Collatz = the assertion that such classes never meet Z+." 2>&1 | tail -1
ailog validate 2>&1 | tail -1
